headlines.title: Stock markets plunge as Nasdaq erases 2026 gains
headlines.description: The surging stock market of 2026 wiped out gains for the year in the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite while the S&P 500 and the Dow entered correction territory, meaning they have declined 10% from recent peaks. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Trump says he won't allow U.S. companies to build data centers outside the country
headlines.description: President Trump told White House reporters that he and Chinese President Xi discussed "joint guardrails" on artificial intelligence. He also announced that, unlike chips, American companies will be prohibited from building data centers outside the U.S.

headlines.title: Man found guilty of starting deadly Palisades Fire in Los Angeles
headlines.description: LOS ANGELES — Almost five months after a first trial ended in a mistrial, a jury found a man guilty of starting the devastating 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles that displaced thousands of people and became the most destructive wildfire in Los Angeles city history.

headlines.title: Trump calling Putin ‘my friend’ at APEC summit sparks backlash
headlines.description: When President Donald Trump called Vladimir Putin his “friend” this week, European leaders and foreign policy experts were dismayed and alarmed.

headlines.title: New cervical cancer guidance to favor HPV screening over traditional Pap tests
headlines.description: New cervical cancer guidance to recommend for the first time that women ages 30 to 65 be screened for HPV rather than with the traditional Pap test.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Iraqi security forces deploy in Iran-backed militia stronghold
headlines.description: JURF AL-SAKHAR, Iraq — Iraqi security forces deployed in Jurf al-Sakhar, a stronghold of the Kataib Hezbollah armed group, on Friday under a deal that seeks to limit the reach of Iran’s most powerful Shi’ite militia ally in the country without provoking a confrontation.

headlines.title: Police are investigating the death of a fan after an altercation at Cowboys game
headlines.description: Police in Texas said they are investigating the death of a fan who died days after an altercation at a Cowboys game.

headlines.title: ICE spent $13 million a month for empty beds, government watchdog reports
headlines.description: ICE spent an estimated $13 million a month for empty beds at five recently acquired detention centers and overpaid by more than 50% for nine megawarehouses — most of which the immigration enforcement agency is now trying to offload, according to a new report from the government’s watchdog.
